title: One Day Your Parents Will Ask Less Questions
body:
As students, we often joke about how many questions our parents ask.

When did you wake up?
Did you eat?
How are your studies?
When are you coming home?

Sometimes it feels endless.

But imagine a day when those questions stop.

Not because they stopped caring, but because time has changed things.

Suddenly, those questions that once felt repetitive become precious memories. The calls become shorter. The conversations become fewer.

Life teaches us that we often appreciate things most after they become rare.

That is why it is important to value the people who check on us while they still can.

 "One day, the questions you ignore today may become the conversations you miss tomorrow."
